name: CODA-LM
description: CODA-LM is the first benchmark for automatic evaluation of large vision-language models (LVLMs) on self-driving corner cases. It uses a hierarchical data structure and prompts LVLMs to analyze complex driving scenes, providing high-quality pre-annotations and enabling quantifiable assessment of LVLMs' performance in challenging self-driving scenarios.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with emerging interest in the autonomous-driving LVLM community, but not yet widely established.
notes: Benchmark includes use of text-only LLMs as judges and supports evaluation of LVLMs on severe road corner cases.
